clusters.description:
Reading: Component(s).SugarPortion -[is dissolved in]-> TeaPortion.Whole.

SugarPortion end — role: Component, multiplicity 0..1
(a TeaPortion contains at most one SugarPortion (1) —
we model a single dissolved serving, not granules —
but unsweetened tea is perfectly valid, hence the lower bound of 0.)

TeaPortion end — role: Composite, multiplicity 1 (default, not shown)
(a dissolved SugarPortion belongs to exactly one TeaPortion.
Once dissolved, it cannot exist independently.)

Composition semantics (filled diamond):
This is a composite aggregation — the strongest ownership in UML.
The SugarPortion cannot exist independently of the TeaPortion
once it has been dissolved:
drinking the tea means consuming the sugar along with it.
There is no natural way to separate the sugar back out —
you would have to discard the entire TeaPortion.
A dissolved SugarPortion may belong to at most one TeaPortion
at any point in time.

Note: in a later extension of this model, TeaPortion will be
aggregated (hollow diamond, shared) into a GlassOfTea,
because tea can be poured into a different glass,
or split across two glasses to cool faster.
That relationship will be modelled as aggregation, not composition.

Direction of reading is shown on the diagram by a filled triangle
next to the association name label.
The association direction itself is Unspecified.
